name: CLI Task Runtimes
description: Use local Codex or Claude Code CLIs as task runtime backends.

configSchema.label: Task Runtime
configSchema.description: Choose which backend owns normal task execution.

configSchema.label: Working Directory
configSchema.description: Project directory for Codex/Claude Code. Empty uses the current process directory.

configSchema.label: Command
configSchema.description: Override the selected CLI command. Empty uses codex or claude.

configSchema.label: Model
configSchema.description: Model argument passed to the external CLI. Empty uses the CLI default.

configSchema.label: Timeout Ms
configSchema.description: Maximum duration for one external CLI task run.

configSchema.label: Extra Args
configSchema.description: Additional external CLI args separated by spaces.
